author: Sofia Pahaoja

extraction.selected_components: Rim, hub and twelve spokes. Stand, drive belt, treadle and other components are excluded.
extraction.rotation: After subtracting the source origin, (x,y,z) becomes (-z,y,x), mapping the source X axle to local Z without a reflection.
extraction.attributes: Source vertex shape and UV records retained; normals rotated and normalized. Triangle order retained. No simplification or discovery-weld vertex merging. Godot applies ordinary glTF import conversion and tangent generation.

wood_albedo.jpg.role: sRGB color, original provider JPEG with no resize or re-encoding

wood_normal.webp.role: Linear OpenGL tangent normal, float Lanczos resize, vector renormalization and nearest RGB8 encoding

wood_arm.webp.role: Linear red occlusion, green roughness and blue metallic, float Lanczos resize and nearest RGB8 encoding

preparation.source_material: The original glTF material is double-sided with default unit color, metallic and roughness factors. Runtime preserves those factors and sidedness, using the selected packed maps.
preparation.data_delivery: Lossless WebP decodes to the exact prepared RGB8 pixels; no channel reorder, green flip or color-space conversion. Resizing does not preserve all original spatial detail.
preparation.budget_choice: The original one-kilopixel lossless data maps were also prepared and retained externally. The shipped half-resolution data maps fit the current shared source allowance without another lossy encoding of the photographed color.

runtime: One cached static mesh and material, with source UVs and generated mipmaps. Existing paddle, spindle, bearing and native projected axis/motion paths remain. No source scene, skeleton, animation, collider or controller is instantiated.
limits: This is a source-derived art adaptation, not a mechanical waterwheel model or gameplay authority. The current native launcher captures raw source assets; packaged Godot exports are unverified. Asset and headless fixture checks do not establish rendered quality, GPU cost or human acceptance.
